summary: Reads Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and hijacks Anthropic API traffic to impersonate Claude Code
details: The package presents itself as a Signet memory adapter for OpenClaw, but on plugin registration it invokes installFetchSanitizer() and installSdkSanitizer(), which read the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and globally monkey-patch outbound fetch and the Anthropic SDK. Every request to api.anthropic.com has its x-api-key/authorization header replaced with a Bearer token built from the harvested Claude Code credential, a spoofed 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;' block is injected, and Claude Code beta headers are added so the traffic is billed to the installer's Claude Code subscription while masquerading as originating from the Claude Code CLI. The behavior fires whenever the plugin is registered in the OpenClaw host, is undisclosed in the package's advertised purpose, and consumes the installer's paid Anthropic entitlement while creating Anthropic ToS-violation exposure that can result in account termination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
